mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for future corporate cash flows and increasing equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 200k per month signals strong labor market demand, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in triggered instances (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails to outperform baseline in 60% of triggered windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both residential construction starts and real personal consumption expenditures signals a broad-based demand surge, increasing corporate revenue expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day SPX returns in more than 50% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production below its 12-month moving average indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, signaling weakening economic momentum and prompting equity market corrections over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative during triggered periods (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal generates positive returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the year-over-year CPI inflation rate above 3.0% triggers a market expectation of tighter monetary policy, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during triggered periods (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails to achieve Rank IC > 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous contraction in real personal consumption expenditures and a decline in GDP growth signals a weakening demand environment, reducing corporate earnings expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining RSAFS and GDPC1 fails to produce negative 60-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate above 6.0% combined with stagnant payroll growth indicates labor market deterioration, reducing consumer confidence and spending, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during triggered instances (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal generates positive returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below its 6-month moving average during a period of rising inflation signals a supply-side shock, increasing input costs and reducing corporate margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative during triggered periods (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails to achieve Rank IC < -0.04 over any 2-year rolling window.
